metadata.case_name: CHEUNG KWOK KEUNG v. YIP MAN HING BUILDING MATERIALS CO LTD AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: self-employed as a delivery worker with his van
plaintiff.occupation_after: self-employed van driver and delivery worker (part-time)

injuries.description: traumatic fracture of right hip (neck of femur). It was a Garden type IV comminuted fracture.
source: The diagnosis was traumatic fracture of right hip (neck of femur) after X-ray of pelvis. It was a Garden type IV comminuted fracture. On 6 February 2007, a closed reduction and screw fixation was done as an emergency operation.

injuries.description: Avascular Necrosis (AVN) of right femoral head (Ficat type III) with articular collapse and early ostoarthropathy.
source: On 9 November 2009, Cheung complained about increased hip pain. An X-ray examination disclosed features of Avascular Necrosis (“AVN”) of right hip and no cut-out of screws was noted. Cheung was referred to the Arthroplasty clinic at UCH. A MRI examination was performed in July 2010 and it showed right femoral head AVN with articular collapse and early ostoarthropathy.

There was a joint expert report by Dr. Chien Ping Eric and Dr. Poon Kai Ming dated 21 September 2010. They confirmed that Cheung suffered from the diagnosis of (1) Garden type IV, comminuted fracture of the right neck of femur and (2) complications of the fracture, namely, AVN, Ficat type III.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: right hip pain and soreness with limited walking pace

treatments_received.treatment: closed reduction and screw fixation (emergency operation)
source: On 6 February 2007, a closed reduction and screw fixation was done as an emergency operation.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Closed reduction for fracture of arm / leg / patella / pelvis with internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: second closed reduction and internal fixation
source: Cheung underwent another operation to have a second close reduction and internal fixation on 9 February 2007.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Closed reduction for fracture of arm / leg / patella / pelvis with internal fixation

treatments_received.treatment: removal of screws and hip arthroscopy
source: An operation for removal of screws and hip arthoscopy was performed on 3 December 2010. Cheung was discharged on 8 December 2010 walking with elbow crutches on partial weight-bearing.
Between 13 March 2007 and 25 October 2007, Cheung attended a total of 24 treatment sessions at the Physiotherapy Department of UCH.
Cheung also received Chinese medical treatments with acupuncture at Kwong Wah Hospital for about 24 times.
Cheung also attended private orthopaedic consultation. He attended Dr. Yeung Kong Fan’s clinic once and Dr. Chan Sai Keung’s clinic once.

Both Dr. Chien and Dr. Poon opined that Cheung was likely to develop early degenerative conditions of his right hip. Manual labour work would accelerate degeneration. Symptoms of pain and stiffness would appear. Hip replacement can relieve such pain and stiffness and improve the function of his right hip with post-operative rehabilitation.
the cost for the rehabilitation after the first and revision surgery would range from HK$25,000 to HK$50,000.
I would however only allow HK$200,000 for the initial hip replacement operation and HK$35,000 for rehabilitation costs.
